which primarily includes desktop and notebook microprocessors, accelerated processing units that integrate microprocessors and graphics, chipsets, discrete GPUs, data center and professional GPUs and development services. • the Enterprise, Embedded and Semi-Custom (EESC) segment, which primarily includes server and embedded processors, semi-custom SoC products, development services and technology for game consoles. • the Xilinx segment, which primarily includes FPGAs, adaptive SoC products, and ACAP products. In addition to these reportable segments, the Company has an All Other category, which is not a reportable segment. This category primarily includes certain expenses and credits that are not allocated to any of the reportable segments because management does not consider these expenses and credits in evaluating the performance of the reportable segments. This category primarily includes amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, employee stock-based compensation expense and acquisition-related costs.
